The '''FT-6 Pike''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[FT-series]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] starfighters produced by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. Similar to other models of the series, the Pike had two wings and three rear engines. The Pike differed from the [[PT-7 starfighter]] in that it featured two cannons on each wing, while the PT-7 only had one.<ref name="GS" />
